# Britannica

> Britannica's Curiosity Compass is an interactive personality assessment platform that matches users to curiosity archetypes and connects them with famous explorers, scientists, and inventors throughout history.

The Curiosity Compass combines self-discovery tools with educational content about historical figures and their contributions to science, exploration, and innovation. It serves as an engaging entry point for learning about different approaches to knowledge and discovery.

## Key Topics

- Curiosity Compass
- Personality Quiz
- Career Exploration
- Curiosity Assessment
- Self-Discovery
- Explorer Archetype
- Scientist Profile
- Inventor Profile
- Famous Explorers
- Marie Curie
- Grace Hopper
- Amelia Earhart
- Personal Growth
- Learning Discovery
- Neuroscience of Curiosity

## Curiosity Compass Hub

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass](https://curiosity.britannica.com/): Main product hub for discovering your curiosity type through interactive assessment and personality matching

## Curiosity Archetypes

- [I'm an Explorer!](https://curiosity.britannica.com/explorer): Explorer personality profile showcasing adventurers and their journeys of discovery
- [I'm a Scientist!](https://curiosity.britannica.com/scientist): Scientist personality profile featuring Marie Curie and the pursuit of scientific discovery
- [I'm an Inventor!](https://curiosity.britannica.com/inventor): Inventor personality profile featuring Grace Hopper and the history of innovation
